desc_en: This short sleeve midi dress presents a tailored, flattering design with a classic round neckline. Its fluid silhouette embraces body lines with timeless elegance. Crafted to offer versatility and sophistication for any occasion. Each piece is made to order in the United States with worldwide shipping.
